spans.s:
पुपूषत् पुपूषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. Desid. of
rt. 1. पू), wishing to cleanse or purify.

पुपूषा, f. the wish or desire to cleanse or
purify.

पुप्पुट पुप्पुट, अस्, m., N. of a particular
disease, swelling of the palate and gums.

पुप्फुल पुप्फुल, अस्, m. flatulency, wind
in the stomach.

पुप्फुस पुप्फुस, अस्, m. the lungs [cf.
फुप्फस]; the pericarp or seed-pod of a lotus.

पूप पूप, अस्, m. a cake, a sort of bread;
[cf. अपूप.]
—पूप-शाला, f. a cake room, baker's
shop (according to Kullūka = अपूप-विक्रय-वेश्-
मन्).
—पूपाष्टका (˚प-अष्˚), f. the eighth day
of the wane of the moon after the day Āgrahāyaṇī.

पूपला or पूपलिका or पूपली, f. a kind of
sweet cake fried with ghee or oil, a rich cake of
wheaten flour.
पूपालिक, अस्, आ, m. f. a cake.

पूपाली, f. a sort of cake or biscuit made of meal
or barley half baked or fried.

पूपिका, f. a sort of cake half baked or fried in
oil or ghee.
पूपीय or पूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ.
